gloss: to run around trying to escape; to flee in all directions

definitions.gloss: to run around trying to escape; to flee in all directions; to keep dodging
definitions.explanation: To repeatedly flee or move around in an attempt to avoid being caught, found, or confronted. Suggests sustained, frantic evasion rather than a single act of running away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{家中|いえじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: The dog ran around the house trying to escape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The suspect is running around trying to evade the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧{取|と}り⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}る⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: I'm tired of a life spent dodging debt collectors.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive godan verb. Compound of ⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (to flee) + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around). The 〜⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ suffix adds a sense of doing the action repeatedly or all over.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}る: to keep running from ~
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}る: to keep dodging responsibility
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}る: to run around here and there

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧: to flee — single act of escaping; no sense of repeated movement
- ⟦{逃|に}げ{出|だ}す→逃げ出す：06041_nigedasu⟧: to break out, run away — emphasizes the start of fleeing
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{切|き}る→振り切る：06703_furikiru⟧: to shake off — succeed in escaping a pursuer
